purpose: Make every hosted KEP action start from an isolated role and identity session with exact public preflight and resumable operation state.
product_outcomes: fresh task sessions do not inherit another role or identity
one human or wallet may control distinct protocol identities without identity collapse
shared wallet custody is disclosed before protocol effects
A and B can export exact public preflight material before signing
effectful operations retain one stable identifier through reconciliation
exact identity registration resumes while binding conflicts remain rejected
attempt identifiers resolve to bounded safe evidence
business_outcome: Participants can understand and reproduce who is acting, under which identity, with which public inputs, before an exchange changes hosted or Devnet state.
